name: Tokiwa Fujika
source:
Her mother is a high-ranking member of the overseas mafia, but her father (Japanese) is an ordinary office worker. How he met her wife is a mystery. Her parents raised Fujika as a normal child. In both middle and high school, she went to a strictly all-girls school. She took a short break before entering university, but was surprised to at the amount of men there.

Quiet, optimistic, and easy-going. She's both a good talker and a good listener, allowing her to get along well with everyone. On the other hand, if she doesn't care about something she'll be indifferent.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
